# Zen Lineage

> An open-source interactive encyclopedia of Chán, Zen, Sŏn, and Thiền
> Buddhist history, with master profiles, schools, teachings, and a
> published teacher–student lineage graph.

Zen Lineage maps teacher–student relationships from Shakyamuni Buddha through
Bodhidharma to modern teachers. The site records citations and marks uncertain
lineage links for further review.

The project covers Chinese Chán, Japanese Zen (Rinzai, Sōtō, Ōbaku),
Korean Sŏn, and Vietnamese Thiền traditions.

## Main Pages

- [Masters index](https://zenlineage.org/masters): Browse published master profiles chronologically with search
- [Schools index](https://zenlineage.org/schools): School branches with master counts
- [Lineage graph](https://zenlineage.org/lineage): Interactive visualization of the published lineage
- [Proverbs](https://zenlineage.org/proverbs): Zen proverbs, kōans, and sayings, with attribution where supported
- [Timeline](https://zenlineage.org/timeline): Chronological history from 500 BCE to present
- [About](https://zenlineage.org/about): Comprehensive introduction to Zen Buddhism with scholarly citations

## Data

- [Lineage graph data (JSON)](https://zenlineage.org/data/graph.json): Nodes and edges included in the published graph
- [Masters dataset (JSON)](https://zenlineage.org/api/masters.json): Published master profiles with names, dates, schools, and biographies
- [Complete reference (Markdown)](https://zenlineage.org/llms-full.txt): Available master biographies, school descriptions, and cited teachings in one document
- [Source code](https://github.com/echojoel/zenlineage): Full open-source repository

## Optional

- [About — etymology, practice, history](https://zenlineage.org/about): Detailed scholarly essay on Zen Buddhism
